avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces acalabrutinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2 weeks washout before starting acalabrutinib

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease acalabrutinib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use alternative immune support; consult oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase acalabrutinib levels minimally
caution_supplements.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased side effects if used

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inhibitory effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standardized supplements at moderate doses; discuss with provider

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases acalabrutinib plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; includes pomelo and Seville oranges

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase acalabrutinib absorption; absorption is food-independent but fatty foods may alter kinetics
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

monitoring_notes: Acalabrutinib is extensively metabolized via CYP3A4; monitor for efficacy loss with enzyme inducers and toxicity with enzyme inhibitors. Regular assessment of bleeding risk and lymphocyte counts is warranted, particularly when dietary or supplement changes occur.
